methodology.thread_control: threadpool_limits for BLAS and OpenMP; mykmeans n_threads identical
methodology.fixed_initialization: identical explicit centers, sampled without replacement with RandomState(2026)
methodology.end_to_end: each estimator performs its own greedy k-means++; same random_state, seeds need not match
methodology.timing_exclusions: data generation, warmup, independent inertia calculation, ARI
methodology.quality_note: speed ratios are meaningful together with objective/iterations; end-to-end seeds may differ
methodology.scope: synthetic dense CPU workloads; no universal performance guarantee
